title: 第一卷 第17章 不会是她穿过的吧第一卷 第18章 师兄一路走好
content_zh:
“陈师弟不要误会，我和郸师弟交情匪浅，并非有特殊癖好。”
出了郸呈的房间，李沧海对陈玄说道。
陈玄不予置评，只是安静聆听。
“当年我尚未拜师万长老时，曾在丹房待过一些时日，那时他是师兄，我是师弟，如今身份互换，称谓虽是变了，但在我心中，他一直是我最敬仰的郸师兄。”
说起往事，李沧海脸上挂着怀念的神情。
可在陈玄看来，这表情未免有些……
略带娇羞。
还有脸上那该死的红晕是什么鬼啊喂！
“郸师兄为人随和，极少与人起冲突，苏若烟当真是太过分了，我稍后便去趟执事殿，定要让她付出些代价才行，不然她还以为我灵药峰软弱可欺！”
李沧海转过头看了眼陈玄，从袖中取出一个玉牌递过去，道，“这是传音玉，若是再出了事，只需将法力注入其中，便可与我联系，劳请师弟照顾好他，我这便去了！”
“唉！”
陈玄刚想说两句，李沧海却是已如一阵风般离开。
看来郸师兄在这位李仙子……仙长心中的分量确实不轻的。
只是这般鲁莽行事，倒是与外貌差别过大。
苏若烟一直蛮横无理，也不是没有其他人看她不顺眼，却是从没出过事，可见其背景深厚。
如果执事殿管用的话，想来早就被逐出山门了。
怕就怕李沧海这次莽撞告状，不仅没法遏制苏若烟，还会起到适得其反的效果，让她怀恨在心，后续报复来得更加猛烈。
陈玄收回伸出的手，长叹口气。
有灵药峰万长老这层背景，倒是不怕李沧海受到报复，可郸呈……难说！
陈玄皱着眉走进丹房。

开始逐步清理丹炉中的灰烬残渣，花费一个多时辰才将炉灰清出。
也是不出所料地收获两颗鸡蛋大小的废丹。
清完炉灰已是太阳西斜，擦了擦额头的汗水，看了眼满是烧灼痕迹的丹炉。
“只能明天再擦拭丹炉了。”
自言自语一句，拿起扫把简单打扫了丹炉周围，默认已完成今日份工作。
转身朝自己的房间走去。
进屋关门、拉门栓、抵木棒。
从袖兜掏出两颗废丹，拉出陶罐丢进去，重新推回床底下，这一套流程已相当熟练。
坐在床边，看了眼传音玉。
李沧海也是脑袋瓜有些迟钝，使用方法是说给他了，那也得他有法力才行啊！
又不是看不出他是个连炼气境都没到的小渣渣，这些修仙的真是……光顾着修金丹，不想着修元神。
修仙都修成‘仙呆子’了不是？
“晚点还是将传音玉给郸师兄吧。”
陈玄收起传音玉，对飞仙门未来有深深的担忧。
看来栾清萍的单纯并非个例，加上蛮横小仙女苏若烟，挑事的手段就跟没开智的孩童一般，搞得他都不得不同流合污，强行将自己智商按在地上摩擦，不然显得不合群……
想想以后飞仙门，一群修为高深的‘糖人’飞来飞去，一言不合就大打出手，那场面……啧啧！
不敢想，没眼看。
不过很多事情不可一概而论，飞仙门还是有不少正常人。
content_en:
"Junior Brother Chen, don't get me wrong. Junior Brother Dan and I have a close friendship. We don't have any special hobbies."
After leaving Dan Cheng's room, Li Canghai said to Chen Xuan.
Chen Xuan made no comment and just listened quietly.
"Back then, before I became a disciple of Elder Wan, I spent some time in the alchemy room. At that time, he was the senior brother and I was the junior brother. Now the identities have been swapped. Although the titles have changed, in my heart, he has always been the senior brother I admire most."
Speaking of the past, Li Canghai had a nostalgic look on his face.
But in Chen Xuan's opinion, this expression is a bit...
A little shy.
And what the hell is that damn blush on your face?
"Senior Brother Dan is an easy-going person and rarely conflicts with others. Su Ruoyan really went too far. I will go to the Deacon Hall later and make her pay some price, otherwise she will think that I, Spiritual Medicine Peak, are weak and can be bullied!"
Li Canghai turned his head and looked at Chen Xuan, took out a jade token from his sleeve and handed it over, saying, "This is the sound transmission jade. If something happens again, you only need to inject mana into it to contact me. Please take care of him, junior brother, I will go now!"
"Alas!"
Chen Xuangang wanted to say a few words, but Li Canghai left like a gust of wind.
It seems that Senior Brother Dan has a very important role in Fairy Li... Immortal Chief's heart.
But acting so recklessly is quite different from his appearance.
Su Ruoyan has always been arrogant and unreasonable, and it's not like no one else dislikes her, but she has never had any trouble, which shows that she has a deep background.
If the Deacon Hall had worked, I would have been expelled from the mountain gate long ago.
She was afraid that Li Canghai's reckless complaint would not only fail to contain Su Ruoyan, but would also have the opposite effect, making her hold a grudge and subsequent revenge would be even more violent.
Chen Xuan retracted his outstretched hand and sighed.
With the background of Elder Wan of the Spiritual Medicine Peak, he is not afraid of Li Canghai being retaliated against, but Dancheng... it's hard to say!
Chen Xuan walked into the alchemy room with a frown.
I began to gradually clean up the ashes and residues in the alchemy furnace, and it took more than an hour to clear out the ashes.
As expected, I harvested two waste pills the size of eggs.
After cleaning the ashes, the sun was already setting. I wiped the sweat from my forehead and looked at the alchemy furnace which was full of burn marks.
"We can only clean the alchemy furnace tomorrow."
Saying something to himself, he picked up the broom and briefly cleaned the area around the alchemy furnace, assuming that he had completed today's work.
Turn around and walk towards your room.
When entering the house, close the door, pull the bolt, and hold the wooden stick against it.
He took out two waste elixirs from his sleeve pocket, pulled out the clay pot, threw it in, and pushed it back under the bed. This process was quite familiar.
Sitting on the edge of the bed, he glanced at the Sound Transmission Jade.
Li Canghai is also a bit slow-minded. The method of using it was told to him, so he must have the magic power to do it!
It's not like we can't see that he is a little scumbag who hasn't even reached the Qi Refining stage. These immortal cultivators really... only focus on cultivating the golden elixir and not thinking about cultivating the soul.
Those who practice immortality have become ‘immortal fools’, right?
"It's better to give the sound transmission jade to Senior Brother Dan later."
Chen Xuan put away the sound transmission jade and was deeply worried about the future of Feixian Sect.
It seems that Luan Qingping's innocence is not an exception. Coupled with the overbearing little fairy Su Ruoyan, her method of provoking troubles is like that of an ignorant child. He has to join in the same trend and forcefully rub his IQ on the ground, otherwise he will appear unsociable...
Think about the scene in the Feixian Sect in the future, where a group of highly cultivated ‘sugar men’ would fly around and fight if they disagreed with each other... tsk tsk!
I don't dare to think about it, I don't have the eyes to see it.
However, many things cannot be generalized. There are still many normal people in Feixianmen.
